note: Rules of g5c-triage: what a diagnostics bundle (tools/cli/g5c-diag) is checked for. kinds: log (a regular expression in the logs of a function, at least `min` times), metric (the sum of a series in the metrics snapshot against a threshold), config (a regular expression that must be absent or present in a configuration), certificate (days to expiry), warnings (lines of level WARN or ERROR, per function). severity: high, medium, low. runbook: a heading of docs/ops/runbooks.md.

rules.title: failure injection is configured
rules.advice: amf.inject / smf.inject make the function refuse or delay on purpose. Remove it from a production configuration.

rules.title: the SBI of a function is served without TLS
rules.advice: Set sbi.tls (certificate, key, CA) and use https in the peer addresses; g5c-init writes a PKI.

rules.title: the NRF does not enforce access tokens
rules.advice: oauth2: { enforce: true } on every function lets only the NRF's tokens through.

rules.title: a certificate expires within 30 days
rules.advice: Renew it (g5c-cluster.sh certs renew, or your CA) and send SIGHUP to reload without a restart.

rules.title: the UPF refuses or does not answer N4 requests
rules.advice: Check that the UPF runs and is associated (heartbeat), its N4 address, and its log for the cause code.

rules.title: a UPF was lost or restarted: its sessions were released
rules.advice: Find why the UPF restarted; UEs re-establish their sessions.

rules.title: UEs do not answer paging
rules.advice: Several failures together point at a gNB or a tracking area that is down; a few are UEs out of coverage.

rules.title: many UEs are de-registered implicitly
rules.advice: The periodic registration timer (amf.timers.t3512) plus the grace (amf.reachable_grace) may be shorter than the UEs' real timers.

rules.pattern: (UDM registration failed|subscription data unavailable|the UDM did not accept)
rules.title: functions cannot reach the UDM
rules.advice: Check the UDM and the UDR behind it, then the NRF registrations.

rules.pattern: (PCF .*(answered [45][0-9][0-9]|did not answer)|SM policy could not be obtained)
rules.title: the PCF does not give SM policy
rules.advice: Check the PCF and the policy files, and the subscriber's DNN and slice.

rules.title: the charging function does not answer or refuses
rules.advice: Check the CHF, the subscriber's balance and smf.chf.

rules.title: registrations are being rejected
rules.advice: g5c-why on the AMF log explains the causes per subscriber.

rules.title: the AMF refused registrations with cause #22
rules.advice: amf.overload is set below the offered rate; raise it or add capacity.

rules.title: a function answers 503
rules.advice: A limit was reached (pool, sessions, workers) or the function is overloaded.

rules.title: fewer functions registered at the NRF than a core needs
rules.advice: A function is down or cannot register.

rules.title: many warnings and errors in a function's log
rules.advice: Read the most frequent ones with g5c-why or grep.
